id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|153a: "People badmouthed the parade crew, but they're a blast! I feel awful for talking them down.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|155b: "People badmouthed the parade crew, but they're a blast! I feel awful for talking them down.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1549: "When everyone's down, they just assume the worst. They're actually such a cheerful bunch!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|156a: "When everyone's down, they just assume the worst. They're actually such a cheerful bunch!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|157b: "Listen, this is a secret. They say General Jasper of Heliodor was a monster's puppet all along.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1587: "Which means we Heliodor soldiers have been taking orders from monsters... What a terrifying thought...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1598: "Whoooooa! Ochori, you're the best even now! Ah, I'm so glad I'm alive!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15ae: "I'm really looking forward to the dance show on this beach tonight. It must be wonderful.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15bb: "The dancer and guitarist are in perfect sync. What a lovely show! The trip was worth the splurge!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15cc: "Past the western mountains, there's a village deep in the hills with ruins of an ancient civilization. Ruins are so exotic.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15df: "But rocky cliffs surround it, and even ships can't land. I guess I can't go... What a shame.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|15f1: "They say the Luminary's star fell on Gallopolis. Rumors say the world will end... What will become of us?
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1603: "They say the Luminary's star fell on Gallopolis. I'm worried about the world, but being afraid won't help.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1612: "At least for now, let's cheer up and enjoy ourselves!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|162c: "I'm looking for pretty seashells. I'll take them back to Heliodor as a travel memento. Romantic, isn't it?
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|163e: "A white beach, the rolling sea, passionate guitar and graceful dance... How romantic!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1650: "This man's ship was wrecked at sea, and he barely escaped the sinking vessel. The rest of the crew is still missing...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1663: "He seems to be having terrible nightmares. He must have suffered on that ship. What's this red light he mentions?
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1674: "The world is at peace, yet this man's condition won't clear up.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|167d: "He has an appetite, but whenever I nurse him my face turns bright red. What could it be...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|168c: "Ever since the black sun appeared over Gallopolis, I've felt uneasy. I'm collecting shells to calm my heart.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|169d: "Watching the dancer calms my heart a little, after the frayed nerves from the black sun over the desert.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16bf: "There's another big inn in town, but we've been running this inn here for years! We won't lose to the big one! Now then...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|16d1: "Oh, traveler. After adventuring across that ruined land, you must be exhausted. Please, stay and rest.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|170b: "Across the sea to the northeast lies Octagonia, famous for its arena. The tournament should be on now.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|171d: "If I were a bit more skilled, I'd enter. But I doubt I could beat those veteran fighters...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1731: "They say the last Octagonia tournament was won by the previous champion and a rookie adventurer pair.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|173f: "Even paired with the former champion, winning as a rookie... That fighter must have been terrifyingly strong.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1750: "Ugh... I was badly hurt by a raging monster.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1758: "But so many people died in that blast. I should be grateful just to be alive...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1767: "At last, I can see a strange winged person before my eyes... Maybe an angel has come from the sky for me...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1789: "Sir Diego's students often shop here, so we stock sharp weapons!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|179a: "Thanks to Sir Diego's training, my son became a fine Heliodor soldier. He works at the Mount Pang Lai gate now.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17a9: "He wanted to be a knight since he was little. I can't believe he actually did it. We're so proud.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17be: "The world is full of savage monsters now, and weapons sell well. But I take no joy in this kind of business. Now then...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17d3: "My daughter has done nothing but cry since that day. She misses her soldier brother who never came home.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17df: "I can't tell her he might never return. We don't want to believe it ourselves...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|17f8: "My son, who I thought was dead, came home with the parade!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1802: "His looks and voice changed a lot, but that doesn't matter. I knew he was my son right away.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1825: "Tough monsters fill the seas! But no worries! Our armor will be your reliable ally!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18db: "Tough monsters fill the seas! But no worries! Our armor will be your reliable ally!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1839: "You're a traveler, right? Have you seen that very tall mountain to the north of town?
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1848: "Go take a look, it's worth it. It's a sacred peak called Mount Pang Lai. Ascetic monks live there, they say.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|185a: "That's the sacred Mount Pang Lai. They say ascetic monks live deep within and train hard.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1871: "Customer, in times like these, how about some good armor to protect yourself? It's too late once monsters get you.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1885: "The sacred mountain north of town is Mount Pang Lai. My son worked at the gate at its foot.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1892: "Yggdrasil was just beyond that mountain... The impact must have been far worse than here. I hope it's all right.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18a8: "So you're the parade boss! My son told me. Put our goods to good use! Now then...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18bb: "My son, who kept watch at the Mount Pang Lai gate, was missing for ages. Then he came back looking totally different.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18ca: "I was shocked at first. But as long as he's alive, I wish for nothing more.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18f1: "Have you seen the very tall mountain north of town? It's a sacred peak called Mount Pang Lai.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|18fd: "Until recently, Heliodor's gate sealed it off, but it's open now. Go take a look if you like.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1917: "An adventurer who spots a pier while sailing should land there without hesitation...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1926: "Every adventurer should remember these words. You may meet unknown monsters or find rare treasures.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1948: "Oh, traveler. Did you come by ship? Have you seen the pillar of light rising from the sea?
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|196b: "Oh, traveler. Did you come by ship? Have you seen the pillar of light rising from the sea?
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1957: "That pillar of light overflows with the sea god's power. They say a mystical world lies beneath it.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|197a: "That pillar of light overflows with the sea god's power. They say a mystical world lies beneath it.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1990: "My grandson, this child's brother, was a soldier at the northern gate and our pride. But he's been missing since that day.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|199f: "I've given up on his return, but lately this child saw something outside town and says strange things. What a worry...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19b1: "Who in the world are these people? They don't seem like bad folks...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19bf: "Sir Goliath's mother was a superstar in a certain land. And such a beauty.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19e6: "Sir Goliath's mother was a superstar in a certain land. And such a beauty.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19c9: "She died young after giving birth to Sir Goliath. Everyone was in deep mourning then.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19f0: "She died young after giving birth to Sir Goliath. Everyone was in deep mourning then.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19d6: "Sir Goliath's sunny, cheerful nature must come from his mother.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|19fd: "Sir Goliath's sunny, cheerful nature must come from his mother.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a19: "Hello, traveler. How about a souvenir of Puerto Valor?
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a33: "Long ago, a noble family of master swordsmen from Heliodor moved here to manage the sluice gate to the outer sea.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a44: "Some saw the rich sea and moved here with the knights to open shops. That's how Puerto Valor began.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a54: "Sir Diego is the knights' descendant. His swordsmanship is unmatched, and age hasn't dimmed his manly spirit.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a7f: "Do you know of the Dundrasil tragedy, sixteen years ago?
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a8d: "Dundrasil, a great nation of a thousand years, was attacked by monsters on the day of the Four Nations Summit.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1a9b: "Like a sandcastle washed by waves, I hear Dundrasil turned to a pile of rubble in no time.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1aa8: "And the one who summoned the monsters is the Darkspawn, still on the run. I pray they're caught soon.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ac0: "Everyone knows of it. It shook this town too, and everyone trembled with fear.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1acf: "I hear the Darkspawn, still on the run, summoned the monster army that destroyed Dundrasil.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ade: "Since the Darkspawn appeared, the monsters grow stronger by the day. I pray they're caught soon.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1af6: "Now that Yggdrasil has fallen, where is our late priest's soul wandering, with no place to return to? Now then...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b0d: "A member of the parade offered to take the late priest's place. I was baffled, but he's so funny...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b1b: "He's already settled into the church. I'm sure the Goddess sent him to guide us.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b2c: "The black sun over Gallopolis... Even from across the sea in Puerto Valor, I can feel its evil creeping in.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b39: "Gallopolis is a proud land of knights, so small oddities won't shake it, but this time I'm worried.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b5a: "Our lord, Sir Diego, is a dashing gentleman of great virtue and chivalry.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b69: "Puerto Valor's peace and prosperity are all thanks to Sir Diego. We're truly grateful.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b78: "The sister is putting on a brave face, but she must grieve the priest. The whole town seems gloomy.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b86: "Ever since Sir Diego shut himself in his room, sad things keep happening. I wish something would cheer the town up.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1b96: "Angels are dancing around me. Has my time finally come? Mumble mumble...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ba3: "The new priest is funny, kind, and charming. ...Blush.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bc1: "Hello there, Jiggly! This is a resort hotel run by the Royal Medal Academy.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bca: "It was built as a training camp for Medal Academy students, but it is open to the general public. Now then...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bde: "It was built as a training camp for Medal Academy students, but it is open to the general public. Now then...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1bf3: "Hello, Jiggly. Many badly injured guests are staying at the hotel right now. Now then...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c03: "Welcome, Jiggly! The parade folks are helping out, and it's a great help. Now then...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c2b: "That medal exchanger over there came all the way over the high western mountains to collect medals.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c38: "To go that far for medals, they must hold a charm that captivates people.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c4e: "This is a resort hotel run by the Royal Medal Academy. We usually open it to the general public.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c5c: "If anything happens, please let us know. For instance, if our maid is slacking off. ...Not that she would.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c72: "Sea monsters have turned fierce lately. A giant squid even showed up in Gondolia, and fish keep getting scarcer.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c83: "Word is the one who sent the squid on a rampage was the fugitive Darkspawn. I hope they get caught for the sea's sake.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1c99: "The hotel's seafood is made with fresh-caught ingredients and is all the rage!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cb2: "We just got married. We're here on our honeymoon in this beautiful town.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cbd: "Time flows so gently here and it's so soothing. Maybe we'll settle down here.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1cce: "We came here on our honeymoon. We planned to go to Gallopolis next, but we canceled after hearing of the black sun.

tm.「パレードの連中 悪い風にウワサされてたけど\n サイコーにゆかいで いいヤツら: "People badmouthed the parade crew, but they're a blast! I feel awful for talking them down.
tm.「やっぱり みんな 落ち込んでると\n イヤなほうに 解釈しちゃうんだな。\n: "When everyone's down, they just assume the worst. They're actually such a cheerful bunch!
tm.「いいか これから言うことは 秘密だぞ。\n なんでも デルカダールの将軍 ホメ: "Listen, this is a secret. They say General Jasper of Heliodor was a monster's puppet all along.
tm.「……ということは 俺たちデルカダール兵は\n 今まで 魔物の命令を聞いてたって: "Which means we Heliodor soldiers have been taking orders from monsters... What a terrifying thought...
tm.「うおおおおおおおーーー！\n オチョリちゃん こんな時でも さいこーーー！\n: "Whoooooa! Ochori, you're the best even now! Ah, I'm so glad I'm alive!
tm.「夜 この浜辺で行われるという\n ダンスショーが とっても 楽しみなの。\n: "I'm really looking forward to the dance show on this beach tonight. It must be wonderful.
tm.「踊り子と 弾き手の息が ぴったり合ってて\n とってもステキな ショーね！\n: "The dancer and guitarist are in perfect sync. What a lovely show! The trip was worth the splurge!
tm.「西の岩山を越えた先にある 山奥の村には\n 大昔に栄えた 古代文明の遺跡がある: "Past the western mountains, there's a village deep in the hills with ruins of an ancient civilization. Ruins are so exotic.
tm.「……けど その村の周りは 岩山に囲まれてて\n 船でも 上陸できないんですって: "But rocky cliffs surround it, and even ships can't land. I guess I can't go... What a shame.
tm.「サマディー王国に 勇者の星が落ちたそうよ。\n 世界が終わるだとか ウワサが流: "They say the Luminary's star fell on Gallopolis. Rumors say the world will end... What will become of us?
tm.「サマディー王国に 勇者の星が落ちたそうよ。\n 世界がどうなっちゃうのか 不安: "They say the Luminary's star fell on Gallopolis. I'm worried about the world, but being afraid won't help.
tm.「せめて 今だけでも\n パァッと 楽しまなくっちゃ！: "At least for now, let's cheer up and enjoy ourselves!
tm.「キレイな貝殻を 探しているの。\n 故郷の デルカダール王国に持ちかえって\n: "I'm looking for pretty seashells. I'll take them back to Heliodor as a travel memento. Romantic, isn't it?
tm.「たゆたう海を背に 真っ白な浜辺で\n 情熱的なギターの音色と 華麗な舞い……\: "A white beach, the rolling sea, passionate guitar and graceful dance... How romantic!
tm.「この方 海を航海中に いきなり船が大破して\n 沈みゆく船から 辛くも脱出した: "This man's ship was wrecked at sea, and he barely escaped the sinking vessel. The rest of the crew is still missing...
tm.「なんだか ひどい悪夢に うなされてるみたい。\n よほど 船の上で おそろしい: "He seems to be having terrible nightmares. He must have suffered on that ship. What's this red light he mentions?
tm.「世界は 平和になったというのに\n この方の症状は なぜか完治しないの。: "The world is at peace, yet this man's condition won't clear up.
tm.「食欲もあるみたいなんだけど\n 看病していると おカオが真っ赤になるのよ。\n: "He has an appetite, but whenever I nurse him my face turns bright red. What could it be...
tm.「サマディーに 黒い太陽が現れてから\n 不安で 胸騒ぎがしてね……。\n 心を: "Ever since the black sun appeared over Gallopolis, I've felt uneasy. I'm collecting shells to calm my heart.
tm.「こうして 踊り子さんのダンスを見てると\n 砂漠の黒い太陽で ささくれだってい: "Watching the dancer calms my heart a little, after the frayed nerves from the black sun over the desert.
tm.「この町には もうひとつ デカイ宿があるけど\n うちは 長年 この町で宿をやっ: "There's another big inn in town, but we've been running this inn here for years! We won't lose to the big one! Now then...
tm.「おや 旅の方 あの荒廃した大地を\n 冒険されてきたならば さぞ お疲れでしょ: "Oh, traveler. After adventuring across that ruined land, you must be exhausted. Please, stay and rest.
tm.「ここから 海を越えた北東の大陸に\n 闘技場で有名なグロッタという町が あって: "Across the sea to the northeast lies Octagonia, famous for its arena. The tournament should be on now.
tm.「私も もうすこし ウデに自信があったら\n 参加してみたかったけど 今の実力じ: "If I were a bit more skilled, I'd enter. But I doubt I could beat those veteran fighters...
tm.「なんでも グロッタの町の武闘大会では\n 前回チャンピオンと 新人の冒険者のペ: "They say the last Octagonia tournament was won by the previous champion and a rookie adventurer pair.
tm.「前回チャンピオンと 組んでいたとはいえ\n いきなり 新人なのに 優勝してしま: "Even paired with the former champion, winning as a rookie... That fighter must have been terrifyingly strong.
tm.「うう…… 凶暴化した魔物にやられて\n 大ケガを負ってしまったんだ。: "Ugh... I was badly hurt by a raging monster.
tm.「けれど あの衝撃で 数えきれないほど\n たくさんの人が 亡くなったっていうし: "But so many people died in that blast. I should be grateful just to be alive...
tm.「ついに 目の前に ハネの生えたヘンな人が\n 見えるようになったんだ……。\n: "At last, I can see a strange winged person before my eyes... Maybe an angel has come from the sky for me...
tm.「ウチには ジエーゴさまの門下生たちが\n よく 買いにくるからね。\n 切れ味: "Sir Diego's students often shop here, so we stock sharp weapons!
tm.「うちの息子は ジエーゴさまの修行のおかげで\n 立派な デルカダールの兵士にな: "Thanks to Sir Diego's training, my son became a fine Heliodor soldier. He works at the Mount Pang Lai gate now.
tm.「小さな頃から 騎士になりたいと言ってたけど\n 本当に なっちまうだなんてねえ: "He wanted to be a knight since he was little. I can't believe he actually did it. We're so proud.
tm.「凶暴な魔物だらけの ものものしい世界になって\n 武器が よく売れるようになっ: "The world is full of savage monsters now, and weapons sell well. But I take no joy in this kind of business. Now then...
tm.「あの日以来 うちの娘 泣いてばかりなんだ。\n 兵士だった息子が 帰ってこなく: "My daughter has done nothing but cry since that day. She misses her soldier brother who never came home.
tm.「もう二度と 帰ってこないかも……なんて\n こわくて 娘に言えないよ。\n …: "I can't tell her he might never return. We don't want to believe it ourselves...
tm.「てっきり 死んじまったと思ってた息子が\n パレードと一緒に 帰ってきたのさ！: "My son, who I thought was dead, came home with the parade!
tm.「……姿や言葉は ずいぶん 変わったけど\n そんなモン 関係ないさ。\n すぐ: "His looks and voice changed a lot, but that doesn't matter. I knew he was my son right away.
tm.「手強い魔物が 海には いっぱい！\n ところがどっこい 心配ご無用！\n ウチ: "Tough monsters fill the seas! But no worries! Our armor will be your reliable ally!
tm.「アンタ 旅の方だね。\n この町から 北のほうにそびえる\n とても高い山を: "You're a traveler, right? Have you seen that very tall mountain to the north of town?
tm.「なんなら 見てみなよ。一見の価値はあるぜ。\n ドゥーランダ山という霊山でね。: "Go take a look, it's worth it. It's a sacred peak called Mount Pang Lai. Ascetic monks live there, they say.
tm.「あの山は ドゥーランダ山という霊山なんだ。\n なんでも 山奥には修行僧が住ん: "That's the sacred Mount Pang Lai. They say ascetic monks live deep within and train hard.
tm.「お客さん こんなご時世だからこそ\n 身を守るために いい防具はどうだね？\n: "Customer, in times like these, how about some good armor to protect yourself? It's too late once monsters get you.
tm.「この町から 北に見える霊山は\n ドゥーランダ山というんだ。うちの息子も\n: "The sacred mountain north of town is Mount Pang Lai. My son worked at the gate at its foot.
tm.「大樹があったのは あの山のすぐ向こうだ……。\n 落ちた衝撃は この町の比じゃ: "Yggdrasil was just beyond that mountain... The impact must have been far worse than here. I hope it's all right.
tm.「アンタ パレードのボスなんだってな！\n 帰ってきた息子から 聞いたぜ。\n: "So you're the parade boss! My son told me. Put our goods to good use! Now then...
